$comment: The kind descriptions of the w2c kinds of the core (V/11.14 Н1.1; ADR-0116 addendum (9)). Lesson data of «Спецификация VMS»: reference basis: api/fixtures/demo.json of the fork at cb728a42cf2708bae186c95607d8edfcda6462fc (the same fixture bytes used for the existing lesson data) (the source of the profile tables of BACKEND.md), narrowed to the w2c translation: the properties are those of mapping.tsv (readOnly by way read and const, writeOnly by write), the capabilities, parents, children, actions and events — what backend translates. from — the places of the kind, write — none, row or assembly (V/11.14 Н1.1). backend gives out description as UnitKind of GET /kinds. profiles — the Profile entries of the reference set for the profiles the kinds implement: GET /kinds gives them as KindsList.profiles.
